author: easemize
name: particle-wave
description: A dynamic and interactive background component for React that renders a mesmerizing wave of particles. Built with three.js for high-performance, GPU-accelerated animation, this component provides a beautiful and engaging visual experience. It's fully responsive and theme-aware, automatically switching between light and dark modes to match your application's design. As part of the EaseMize UI library, it's easy to integrate and great to customize.
